name: .NET Modular + React + PostgreSQL
description: Golden Path for ASP.NET Core .NET 10 APIs built as a modular monolith, with React applications and PostgreSQL.
principles: Security by default and least privilege
Automation that can be verified and reversed

rules.description: The backend does not use NestJS.
rules.remediation: Remove NestJS dependencies and keep the backend on ASP.NET Core.

rules.description: The frontend does not use Next.js.
rules.remediation: Remove Next.js and keep the frontend as a React application.

rules.description: The .NET solution separates Domain, Application, and Infrastructure.
rules.remediation: Organize the .NET solution into business modules with Domain, Application, and Infrastructure layers.

rules.description: There is an independent Domain layer.
rules.remediation: Create the Domain layer and keep business rules and models there, free of infrastructure dependencies.

rules.description: There is an Application layer for use cases.
rules.remediation: Create the Application layer and make use cases, commands, queries, and ports explicit.

rules.description: There is an Infrastructure layer for external adapters.
rules.remediation: Create the Infrastructure layer and keep persistence and external integrations there.

rules.description: Controllers or endpoints form a thin HTTP layer.
rules.remediation: Create thin Controllers or Endpoints that delegate execution to use cases.

rules.description: The public API uses the /api/v1 prefix.
rules.remediation: Version public routes under /api/v1 and document the evolution policy.

rules.description: The API publishes an OpenAPI contract.
rules.remediation: Enable OpenAPI and validate the generated document in the pipeline.

rules.description: HTTP errors follow Problem Details.
rules.remediation: Standardize errors with RFC 9457 Problem Details and stable domain codes.

rules.description: The API authenticates JWT Bearer tokens issued by the OIDC provider.
rules.remediation: Configure JWT Bearer with validated issuer, audience, signature, and clock skew.

rules.description: Authorization is expressed through policies.
rules.remediation: Define policies per business capability and apply them to the endpoints.

rules.description: Authorization uses default deny.
rules.remediation: Set an authenticated FallbackPolicy and grant anonymous access only where it is declared.

rules.description: Persistence uses PostgreSQL through the EF Core Npgsql provider.
rules.remediation: Configure EF Core with Npgsql and keep data access inside Infrastructure.

rules.description: Database changes are versioned as migrations.
rules.remediation: Add versioned migrations and validate them before deployment.

rules.description: The web interface uses React without Next.js.
rules.remediation: Create a React application and organize features by domain.

rules.description: Domain rules and use cases have unit tests.
rules.remediation: Add unit tests for domain rules and for critical use cases.

rules.description: HTTP and PostgreSQL integrations have automated tests.
rules.remediation: Add integration tests for the API and for PostgreSQL persistence.

rules.description: Dependencies between layers are protected by architecture tests.
rules.remediation: Add architecture tests that prevent unwanted dependencies between layers.

rules.description: The application exposes operational health checks.
rules.remediation: Configure liveness and readiness, including the PostgreSQL dependency.

rules.description: Logs are structured and preserve correlation.
rules.remediation: Configure ILogger or Serilog with structured properties and a correlation ID.
